source: Central distinction. ZXNAME0000XZ, ZXNAME0001XZ, and ZXNAME0002XZ can be described primarily by KV-head multiplicity. ZXNAME0003XZ changes the cached representation itself. Calling ZXNAME0004XZ “ZXNAME0005XZ with even fewer heads” is therefore a false mental model.
zh: 中央区别。 ZXNAME0000XZ、ZXNAME0001XZ和ZXNAME0002XZ主要可以通过KV头多重性来描述。 ZXNAME0003XZ 更改缓存的表示本身。因此，称 ZXNAME0004XZ “ZXNAME0005XZ 的头更少”是一种错误的心理模型。
